inputs: research/experiments.csv (via runs.jsonl records with source experiments.csv)

monitor_vs_chip_log.rule: monitor row matched to a harvested run dir by exact run name and chip (desc: rows never match); bpb_2m disagreement = |monitor - log| > 1e-5 where both exist; steps compared where both exist, split into log == monitor + 1 (the monitor quotes the last logged step line) and other

reconciled_monitor_runs_csv.note: NOT an independent check: rows tagged log-confirmed were overwritten from these same logs by the reconciliation (monitor-reconcile-report.md); 29 Sep 23:10 UTC: 18 post-harvest chip C/D full runs appended to monitor-runs.csv from the monitor entries after 16:20 UTC (values read from the chips' eval.log over SSM; no chip_log records, so matched_by_name is unchanged)

semantic_duplicates.rule: desc: record (monitor pseudo-run, no run-dir name) whose bpb_2m agrees with an experiments.csv record's bpb_2m (raw_bpb) to 5 decimal places (|a - b| <= 5e-6), on the same chip, or on any chip when the desc: record's chip is unknown ('?'); one entry per (desc, csv) pair; seed_agrees is null when either seed is unknown
